hero.headline: Try a profession before you
hero.body: Discover what it's really like to be a student in the course you want by doing practical virtual activities. Join us and decide your future with confidence.

destaques.title: Explore on your own terms
destaques.body: Real simulations created by mentors and institutions to help you decide your future.

problema.title: Choosing a course shouldn't be a leap in the dark
problema.body: Every year, thousands of students enter courses they know nothing about. The result? Frustration, late changes, and wasted potential.

cards.sem_referencia_body: Most students choose their course without ever experiencing the profession. They decide based on others' opinions.
cards.tempo_dinheiro_body: Those who discover late that the course isn't right lose entire semesters and resources that could have been better invested.
cards.desalinhamento_body: Students graduate in saturated fields while the market needs profiles that remain unfilled.

steps.step1_body: Choose an area and enter a practical simulation that replicates real day-to-day professional situations.
steps.step2_body: Your actions, time, and decisions generate a unique vocational profile — based on behaviour, not questionnaire answers.
steps.step3_body: You receive recommendations for courses and areas aligned with your real profile. No guesswork.

features.title: Everything you need, in one place

items.simulacoes_body: Guided video, external lab or interactive environment — experience the real day-to-day of each profession.
items.perfil_body: Generated from your behaviour in simulations. No generic questionnaires.
items.cursos_body: Modules, tasks and certificates issued by partner institutions.
items.experiencias_body: Programmes published by partner universities and schools — open and free.
items.mentoria_body: Industry professionals available for personalised guidance.
items.ia_body: Answers your questions with context from your profile and the platform's content.

mentores.title: Learn from those who are already there
mentores.body: Connect with industry professionals for personalised guidance.

cta_final.title: Ready to try it?
cta_final.body: Create your account in seconds and start exploring real simulations. Free. No commitment.
